Glossy Ganesh (h-14 cm)- Silver

The Ganesh Shank (Medium – Dual Tone) is a symbol of positivity, prosperity, and devotion. Featuring a stunning silver-gold dual finish and intricate carvings of Lord Ganesha, this piece perfectly blends spirituality with art. Place it in your puja room, display it as a centerpiece, or gift it to loved ones — this shank brings auspicious energy, beauty, and blessings to every setting. Invite serenity, wisdom, and divine blessings into your space with the Glossy Ganesh (h-14 cm) – Silver idol. Expertly crafted with attention to detail, this elegant Ganesh murti radiates positivity and grace. The glossy silver finish enhances its premium appeal, reflecting light beautifully to create a soothing, divine aura in any setting. Standing 14 cm tall, this idol is perfectly sized to adorn your pooja room, office desk, study area, or display shelves. The intricate detailing on the idol captures Lord Ganesha’s iconic features — the elephant head symbolizing wisdom, the calm expression representing inner peace, and the modak in hand denoting prosperity and sweet rewards of devotion. This piece is more than just a decorative artifact — it’s a spiritual companion that reminds you of new beginnings, wisdom, and success in every endeavor. Whether you are performing daily prayers, seeking a peaceful addition to your décor, or looking for an auspicious gift for friends, family, or colleagues, this idol makes an ideal choice. Its glossy silver surface gives it a contemporary yet traditional charm, making it suitable for both modern interiors and classic spaces. This versatile design fits beautifully in homes, offices, temples, and even as part of festive décor during Ganesh Chaturthi, Diwali, or housewarming celebrations.

  • Premium Quality Material: Made from durable, long-lasting metal that retains its shine.
  • Auspicious & Elegant: Enhances spiritual ambiance while adding a touch of sophistication to your space.
  • Easy to Maintain: Simple to clean and polish, ensuring it stays beautiful for years.
